request:
镜头 s25：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，新闻摄像机长焦，缓慢推近那枚红色镜头。巨大的黑色终端墙中央，红色镜头第一次亮起来，大厅里一排排人仰头看着。扬声器里传出平静的合成声音。环境声：大厅的回声、人群屏住呼吸。
情绪：solemn, awed, ominous
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot on a long news lens, one slow push in toward the red lens
景深与虚实：Long-lens compression; the people in the foreground soft, the lens sharp and glowing.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival 2058 broadcast footage of a solemn handover in a vast hall: rows of officials and engineers stand facing a colossal black terminal wall whose single huge round lens is glowing red for the first time; cold white light, reflections on the polished floor. Blocking lock: the colossal black terminal wall fills the background with the red lens at frame centre; rows of people stand with their backs to camera in the foreground.
Picture 2: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
Picture 3: the 2058 handover hall of the global network authority (location reference; role: location reference). A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. MOSS (calm, polite, emotionless synthetic male voice coming from a loudspeaker) — MOSS（平静、礼貌、没有情绪的合成男声，从扬声器传出）: 我是MOSS。从现在起，由我统一调度。
现场环境声：hall echo, the hush of a large crowd holding its breath, a faint electrical hum

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot on a long news lens, shoulder-mounted ENG broadcast camera with one very slow push in from wide shot to medium wide, the long documentary zoom reaching across the hall without the camera body moving, a slight frame-edge jitter and small searching reframing as the operator steadies himself; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: the colossal black terminal wall fills the background with the red lens at frame centre; rows of people stand with their backs to camera in the foreground from frame left to frame right, the nearest shoulders soft and dark at the bottom edge; the polished floor carries the red reflection up to the base of the wall. Start: the wide frame holds the whole hall, the crowd's heads lifted, the lens at centre still dark except for a thin red rim; the zoom begins to creep in, hot clipped whites blooming off the upper wall panels. Middle: the round lens fully ignites red, the light spilling onto the brushed-steel panel and smearing to the right across the tape; the operator's zoom searches a little tighter, catching the shoulders of the front row going soft and the lens sharpening at frame centre; a faint rolling noise bar passes down the frame and the crowd's silhouettes hold perfectly still. End: the push settles on the glowing red lens and its thin ring, the rows of backs now a dark soft band at the bottom of the frame, red chroma bleeding slightly past the lens edge as the tape holds. Mood: solemn, awed, ominous. Blur: the people in the foreground soft, the lens sharp and glowing; long-lens compression stacking the rows flat against the black wall, the deepest corners of the hall dissolving into murk. MOSS (calm, polite, emotionless synthetic male voice coming from a loudspeaker) says, <d>[Chinese] 我是MOSS。从现在起，由我统一调度。</d>; nobody else says anything intelligible. Final line of this shot: end on "由我统一调度", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Hall echo, the hush of a large crowd holding its breath, a faint electrical hum from the terminal wall, distant shuffle of standing feet on the polished floor, one soft click of a camera shutter, tape hiss; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
